data.narrative:
QunaSys is a Series B quantum computing company that has raised $33M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises a comp universe of 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms, including later-stage peers such as Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using $33M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B progression yields an implied valuation of $63M. This method directly reflects expected value inflation from capital deployment and market validation at the Series B stage.

The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing sector. While 8 private peers exist, none meet the minimum three-datapoint threshold when filtered by stage or valuation tier, making sector-wide medians unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $53M (low) to $72M (high), centered on $63M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single method; a more robust triangulation would require either closer stage-matched peers or public market multiples calibrated specifically to quantum computing fundamentals. Near-term fundraising traction and technical milestones will materially inform whether QunaSys trends toward the range midpoint or upper bound.
